reviews.review:
This review may seem a little redundant considering it is such an old game (nearly a decade). But I think it is still a very relevant 40K based game. And here is why:
[list]
[*]The story is a pretty good 40K story. A bit obvious at times, but captures the essence of the 40K universe
[*]As a shooter, its what you would expect from an IP like 40K. lots and lots of sci-fi-fantasy (sort of) battles. Three Ultramarines versus a horde of xenos. It controls well, nice selection of 40K weapons, a decent enough melee system, semi-competent allies, and Orks that just feel like Orks. or at least how i percieve Orks
[*] The graphics are, obviously, dated. But not by much. You will notice a slight thing here and there, but nothing that takes away from the relative good looks. Again, it feels like 40K should. Gritty, dark, a little moody, and all about never ending warfare.
[/list]

The main complaint most people have is the lack of people playing multiplayer. But thats to be expected for a game this old.
All in all, a good game, that can be a time-sink. Something you can go back to when you get that 40K itch.

This game is an average third person shooter and nothing more.The story, in my honest opinion is OK but it's definitely not great.It feels rather bland compared to the other Warhammer games I've played over the course of several years.However,that has not stopped me from enjoying the multiplayer features.The Exterminatus mode,as boring as it is,can be made fun when playing with friends,the PvP,however,is horrendous and impossible to play with randoms.I like the game but the community is pretty much dead.It's only fun when playing with friends,that's it.
This was an amazing game, still is, if you wanna play single player or coop with a friend. Multiplayer dead.

In leu of recent debacle with the half-assed "remaster"

It seems they have learnt [b]NOTHING[/b] from splitting player bases.
The remaster is the most mediocre half-assed, cash-grab, garbage-deal, greed-ridden, too-damn-late, bogus ass-♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ of the fans, i've seen in a looong time.

That's it, all im gonna add.

-- Old review, but still relevant:
While the singleplayer is fun, it is however somewhat repetetive and short, this game's strength comes in the form of it's multiplayer, not without it's drawbacks though.
-- 
The first negative thing we can talk about when it comes to the multiplayer is the lack of servers for there are none and never was, when you join a game it is PTP based (i belive its called) which means that one of the players in the ongoing game is a host and the rest leeches off of his upload bandwith which can sometimes prove very problematic with disconnections and great lag, sometimes mobs can stand still for several seconds before anything happens.

The second negative thing is the DLC Mulitplayer Mode, This is especially problematic due to its high probability of casuing a split playerbase, when the DLC Dreadnought Assault was released, barely anyone got it on day 1, weeks later it was still a very small portion of the players that had acquired it and a few months after that the playerbase got reduced to a bare minimum, and i suspect the split playerbase of those who had and those who didnt have the DLC is the most likely culprit of the multiplayers demise.

The third negative thing to talk about is that it is now 7 years old which means an even greater lack of a playerbase, getting into games can take a long time and when you do it is probably laggy as hell.

And those are the biggest non-bug issues.
--
There are very few bugs, but when they appear they can be annoying or even prevent you from continuing a game, sometimes mobs can get stuck inside walls and you cant kill them there so you  would have to leave the game and look for a new one.
--
When it comes to graphics they absolutely nailed the look of the Warhammer 40k universe, and it sounds good as well, it's gory, meaty and heavy, not many issues here at all, and the unlocks in multiplayer for costumizing the look of your character is detailed and fun where you can recolor to your liking, sadly even here the game suffers on the DLC craze where alot of chapter-champion armor are locked behind a pay wall.

Overall: 7/10 

Final Note: It's a good game, but with alot of players i would give it 9 for Awesome, but the lack of makes it hard to put a higher score.
